title: Is there a bot that trades from your own wallet, with no API keys and a permission you can revoke yourself? I came up empty.
author: rushapoil
selftext:
By "this way" I mean these four together, not one or two of them:

- it trades on-chain from the wallet you already hold, so there is no deposit and no exchange account
- no API keys anywhere in the loop
- the permission you sign is capped, and you can revoke it yourself without asking anyone
- every fill is a transaction on a public chain, so the record is not the bot's own screen

Plenty of things have one or two. "Non-custodial" gets used loosely enough that it often just means the operator does not hold your exchange password, which is not the same claim at all.

Disclosure so nobody has to dig for it: I built one that works this way, which is exactly why I want to know what else is out there. I am not linking it and this is not a pitch. I have gone through the usual lists and the recommendations in the bot subs and I have not found a second one, and "I could not find it" is a much weaker statement than it sounds.

So: does one exist? If you know it, name it.
